posts.title: The Old Computer Challenge 2026 - Retrospective
posts.description: Tags: occ2026 , blog OCC 2026 Retrospective "Make something." That was the directive for this year's Old Computer Challenge and there were some really impressive interpretations. My entry was a lot simpler than many but that made it easy to stay motivated to finish. I learned about the OCC shortly before it began and it coincided perfectly with my own renewed interest in older computing hardware.

posts.title: The Old Computer Challenge 2026 - Day 6 ProtoWeb
posts.description: Tags: occ2026 , blog This post is mirrored from the FrontPage website . ProtoWeb Let's poke around ProtoWeb a bit today. I won't go over setup here - it's quite easy, just setting up your old web browser to use ProtoWeb's proxy: https://protoweb.org/get-started/ They also have their own fork of RetroZilla that runs on OSes as old as Windows 95 and as new as 11 so you can check it out even on a mod
